note: Which external obligations each control objective helps satisfy (FR-52, G-80). A mapping is a reading, and it says which reading it is: EQUIVALENT where the two describe the same outcome, PARTIAL where the control carries part of a broader requirement or the requirement covers more than the control, SUPPORTS where the control makes the requirement achievable without being what it asks for. Partial is the common case and saying so is the point — a crosswalk that claimed equivalence everywhere would be flattering itself. Every entry names a control this instrument knows and a requirement the loaded framework contains, and the import refuses one that does not resolve at both ends. The reasons are the author's reading; the references are transcribed, not remembered.

mappings.because: both require access permissions and entitlements to be defined, managed and enforced on least privilege
restricting who can reach personal data is one of the measures a controller weighs under security of processing
the framework requires users, services and hardware to be authenticated; multi-factor is one way of doing that, not the whole outcome
privileged access is the sharpest case of the entitlement management this subcategory requires
recertification is how the required management and review of entitlements is evidenced over time
both cover identities and credentials being issued, managed, verified, revoked and audited
remote access is one route by which networks must be protected from unauthorised logical access
remote entry is governed by the same entitlement rules as any other access path
encryption at rest is one means of protecting the confidentiality of data-at-rest
encryption in transit is one means of protecting the confidentiality of data-in-transit
encryption is named in the article as an example of an appropriate technical measure, not as a requirement in itself
minimisation is one of the principles this article states; the control does not carry the others
the article requires minimisation to be built in by design and by default
storage limitation is one of the principles; the control implements it operationally
a working deletion and disposal path is what makes erasure on request possible
disposal is the last stage of the asset life cycle this subcategory covers
secret and configuration handling is part of the configuration management practices required
protecting credentials in configuration is how identity assertions stay protected in transit and at rest
media controls are one way the confidentiality of data-at-rest is protected
hardware retirement and destruction is part of maintaining and removing hardware commensurate with risk
both require networks and environments to be protected from unauthorised logical access and usage
an application firewall protects one class of exposed interface, not the whole environment
an endpoint protection layer is also a place adverse network events are found
interface security covers the application-level entry points within the protected environment
securing interfaces depends on the authorised communication and data flows being represented
denial-of-service protection is one mechanism for achieving resilience in adverse situations
absorbing load is how adequate resource capacity is maintained under attack
both require log records to be generated and made available for monitoring
continuous monitoring covers computing assets and their data; the control also spans the wider estate
monitoring is what makes information from multiple sources available to correlate
vulnerability management is how vulnerabilities in assets are identified, validated and recorded
a disclosure intake is one source feeding the vulnerability process
penetration testing is one of the security tests from which improvements are identified
malicious code protection is one way unauthorised software is prevented from executing
patching is how software is maintained commensurate with risk
release and patch discipline is part of secure development practice
both require backups to be created, protected, maintained and tested
verifying backup integrity before restoring is what makes a backup a recovery capability
the control covers the response capability; this subcategory covers executing the plan once an incident is declared
an incident response plan has to exist and be exercised before it can be executed
a working response process is what makes notification within seventy-two hours achievable
continuity arrangements are one mechanism for resilience in adverse situations
continuity planning is where critical mission functions are established for recovery
flow-down clauses are how supply chain requirements are established and integrated into contracts
the article sets what a processor contract must contain; the control is the contracting practice that meets it
independent assurance is one input to understanding and monitoring supplier risk
assurance evidence is what a pre-acquisition assessment of a critical supplier rests on
knowing the subcontractor chain is part of knowing and prioritising suppliers
the article governs a processor engaging another processor, which is the fourth-party case
third-party access governance is one part of establishing supplier roles and responsibilities
a supplier's access is governed by the same entitlement rules as anyone else's
supplier site access is one case of physical access being managed, monitored and enforced
an approval and acceptance route is how the stated risk response options are exercised
acceptance is one of the risk responses that must be chosen, recorded and tracked
ongoing oversight is how risk management outcomes are reviewed to adjust strategy
reporting is how performance is evaluated and reviewed
screening is one of the human resources practices in which cybersecurity must be included
both require personnel to be given the awareness and training their role needs
specialised roles need training beyond the general awareness programme
documented procedure is how policy becomes something people can follow and audit
both require a lawful basis to be established before personal data is processed
where the basis is consent, the article sets the conditions the control has to meet
the article sets how requests are handled; the control is the capability to answer them
access is the most exercised of the rights the control has to serve
erasure is a right the control has to be able to carry out
notice at collection is one half of the transparency obligation
notice where data came from elsewhere is the other half
special-category processing is prohibited unless a condition applies, which the control is how you evidence
the article governs solely automated decisions with legal or similarly significant effect
communications review is one way legal and regulatory requirements are understood and managed
the control implements the general principle governing transfers out of the Union
appropriate safeguards are the usual route the control has to put in place
model governance carries the risk management system the article requires across the system's lifecycle
a quality management system is where model governance is documented and kept
both require human oversight designed so a person can understand, intervene and stop the system
the article requires training, validation and testing data to be examined for bias; the control is that testing
technical documentation is what explainability evidence is recorded in
the article requires the system to be transparent enough for a deployer to interpret its output
output quality is part of the accuracy and robustness the article requires
personal data in prompts and outputs is processing, and the principles apply to it
data governance covers what personal data enters the model's data sets
bounding what an agent may act on is one way the required oversight is made effective
retrieval has to honour the same entitlements as any other route to the data
both govern the provenance, quality and governance of the data a model is trained on
the article gives an affected person the right to an explanation; the control is the route by which they get one
a working feedback and recourse path is what keeps a complaint from being the only option
